summary_en: This note develops the Cauchy condensation test from the viewpoint of dyadic decomposition and extends the idea to improper integrals and \(L^p\) estimates via distribution functions. It also discusses a monotonicity-based application and gives a standard divergence example involving ∑ \(1/(n\log n)\).

problems.statement_en: If the sequence \(a_n\) is nonincreasing and nonnegative, then the series ∑\_{n\ge 1} a_n converges if and only if the condensed series ∑_k 2^k a\_{2^k} converges.
problems.statement_zh: 序列$a_n$不增，非负，那么级数$\sum_{n\geq1}a_n$的收敛发散性质等价于$\sum_{k}2^ka_{2^k}$的收敛发散性。

problems.statement_en: Let \(f:[1,+\infty)\to\mathbb{R}\) be locally Riemann integrable, nonnegative, and nonincreasing on \([1,+\infty)\). Then the improper integral \(\int_1^{+\infty} f(x)\,dx\) converges if and only if the series \(\sum_{n=1}^{+\infty} 2^n f(2^n)\) converges. Likewise, if \(f:(0,1]\to\mathbb{R}\) is locally Riemann integrable, nonnegative, and nonincreasing on \((0,1]\), then \(\int_0^1 f(x)\,dx\) converges if and only if \(\sum_{n=1}^{+\infty} 2^{-n} f(2^{-n})\) converges.
problems.statement_zh: 设函数$f:[1,+\infty)\to \mathbb{R}$满足下列的条件：1. $f(x)$在该区间上是局部可积的，即对任意闭区间$[a,b]\subset [1,+\infty)$上都是黎曼可积的。2. $f(x)$在该区间上非负单调不增。那么广义积分$\int_{1}^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx$收敛，当且仅当级数$\sum_{n=1}^{+\infty}2^n f(2^n)$收敛。--- 设函数$f:(0,1]\to \mathbb{R}$满足下列的条件：1. $f(x)$在该区间上是局部可积的，即对任意闭区间$[a,b]\subset (0,1]$上都是黎曼可积的。2. $f(x)$在该区间上非负单调不增。那么广义积分$\int_{0}^{1}f(x)\,dx$收敛，当且仅当级数$\sum_{n=1}^{+\infty}2^{-n} f(2^{-n})$收敛。

problems.statement_en: Let \((X,\mu)\) be a measure space and let \(1\le p<\infty\). For a measurable function \(f\), one has \(f\in L^p\) if and only if \(\sum_{k\in\mathbb{Z}} 2^{kp}\,\mu(\{x:|f(x)|>2^k\})<\infty\).
problems.statement_zh: 设$(X,\mu)$为测度空间，$1\leq p<\infty$。对可测函数$f$有$$f\in L^p \iff \sum_{k\in \mathbb{Z}} 2^{kp}\mu(\{x:|f(x)|>2^k\})<\infty$$

problems.statement_en: Let \(f:[0,1]\to\mathbb{R}\) be nonnegative and monotone nondecreasing, and suppose that \(\int_0^1 \frac{f(t)}{t}\,dt<\infty\). Then necessarily \(f(t)\to 0\).
problems.statement_zh: 函数$f:[0,1]\to \mathbb{R}$单调不减，且非负，并且满足$$\int_0^1 \frac{f(t)}{t}\,dt<\infty$$那么一定有$f(t)\to 0$。

problems.statement_en: Prove that the series \(\sum_n \frac{1}{n\log n}\) diverges.
